title: 第3章 如此悲情的表姑娘！(2)

content_zh:
在看看今晚的月色，之前看过的一首词不正是应景了，表姑娘慢慢的念道：“寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。乍暖还寒时候，最难将息。三杯两盏淡酒，怎敌他、晚来风急。雁过也，最伤心，却是旧时相识。满地黄花堆积，憔悴损、如今有谁堪摘？守着窗儿，独自怎生得黑？梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏，点点滴滴，这次第，怎一个愁字了得！”
念了这段李清照最艰难时期写照的一首词，床上的慧姐痛哭不已，压抑的哭声让人不忍劝慰，只希望她痛哭过后就能积极面对日后的生活！
可惜表姑娘叶沁慧每日都这样哀伤不已，住进仁安伯府卢家外祖家，已经将近三年了，每天皆是如此。
可是时间久了，这位表姑娘一不会打理院子，整个院子乱七八糟的，二不会人情世故，每日除了哭还是哭，三不会当家理财，她的那点家底，早被大舅和大舅母骗走了大半。
而且从叶家过来那些近身照顾的人，都被大夫人寻了由头给赶回了叶家，只有奶娘的女儿秀雁，还有慧姐母亲从原城救回来的孤儿青杏还守着表姑娘，其他人都赶走了。
一开始卢家还有人惦记她病了过来照顾她，也知道她手松，能得些好处，之后见她不擅经营，油水越来越少，就都耐烦过来了。
尤其在她看了几本破书，又想到表哥最不喜欢那些俗物市侩的女子，干脆就每月将叶家送来的银子都给了大舅母打点上下，这样一来想占便宜的人，都去讨好大夫人范氏去了，这个叶表姑娘渐渐被遗忘了。
而她自己嫌弃俗气的金银首饰和值钱的东西，也被卢家几个姑娘这样借走那样借走没了影子，肉包子打狗了。
当她知道表哥为了进国子监读书而烦恼银子打点的时候，在表哥的甜言蜜语的诱哄下，就将庄子铺子都交给大表哥打理，只希望将来能和表哥共结连理的时候，这些东西会成为表哥的助力，为了心爱的表哥，就是豁出性命也是甘愿的。
或许慧姐无法想到，她的这些成全，正是让她在后宅这块地方也没了利用的价值，走向了末路的基础，最后只有一些奴婢愿意讨个赏过来，还得看表姑娘高兴不高兴。
若说还有一个人在卢家对她是真好，就是卢家二房的嫡出姑娘卢代菡，或许是她们比较像的原因，代菡的母亲董氏已经去世多年，目前二房的徐氏对她十分不好，但是代菡依然让自己过得更好给徐氏看。
所以代菡经常会过来看看慧姐，也恼恨大伯一家欺人太甚，将慧表妹给弄成这般模样，可是她人微言轻，只能时不时的过来看看，劝慰劝慰。
此时还在痛哭不已的表姑娘，丝毫没感觉这样会不会伤了身子，如此娇美的面孔，满是晶莹的泪水，许是经常流眼泪，漆黑的眼眸也看不出来多么迷人，爱哭的女人时间久了不一定得到别人的可怜，没准是厌烦。
表姑娘叶沁慧就是如此，每天看着繁花落叶，看着日出日落都要哭上许久的她，在读一些凄凄凉凉的诗词，更加哀恸不已，悲切难挡，痛哭流涕。
所以大部分人，只能看见表姑娘叶沁慧眼睛红肿血丝很多，眼睑下鼻子周围都是红彤彤的，大大破坏了精致的容颜，都说爱哭的女人最丑，或者用在这里很恰当。
她看起来苍白异常，哭的上气不接下气的，身子也是赢弱不堪，每日不离手的擦眼泪帕子至少十多条，可惜的是美人常垂泪，无处诉悲情，已经很难有人愿意和她多说几句话了。
再看看房间里面，只有一个杨木的架子床，雕工也不是很好，用料也不是很讲究，屋子里的桌椅板凳也都是一般的成色，柜子里面的衣服也只有几件素淡的绸缎，上面没有绣上什么花色。
只有落寞的梳妆台上，有个金丝楠木的首饰匣子，听说这是御赐的物件，匣子多的金银饰物，但有可能被冷落时间长了，上面都暗沉许多，有的地方还有了一些灰尘。
只有梳妆台上几根玉簪算是油亮很多，可能是经常佩戴的原因，屋子里面桌子上也孤零零的有个茶盘，上面只有四个青花瓷的茶杯，这是表姑娘叶沁慧最喜欢的一套茶具。

content_en:
While looking at the moonlight tonight, a poem I had read before seemed to fit the situation. My cousin read slowly: "Looking for and searching, deserted and deserted, miserable and miserable. It is most difficult to take a breath when it is warm but still cold. Three glasses of wine and two glasses of light wine, how can you defeat him, come late?" The wind is rushing. The geese are passing by, but it is the old acquaintance. The yellow flowers are piled up on the ground, and they are haggard. Who can pick them now? How can I be alone in the dark? At dusk, there is a drizzle. How can I be so sad this time?
After reading this poem that depicts Li Qingzhao's most difficult period, Sister Hui cried bitterly on the bed. Her suppressed cries made people unable to bear consolation. I only hope that after crying, she can face her future life positively!
It's a pity that my cousin Ye Qinhui is so sad every day. It has been nearly three years since she lived in the Lu family's maternal home in Ren'an Bo Mansion, and she has been like this every day.
But as time went by, this cousin girl firstly did not know how to take care of the yard, and the whole yard was in a mess. Secondly, she did not know how to deal with the world. She only cried every day. Thirdly, she did not know how to manage the family's finances. Her uncle and aunt had already defrauded her of most of her little family fortune.
Moreover, those who came from the Ye family to take care of her were all driven back to the Ye family by the eldest lady. Only Xiuyan, the wet nurse's daughter, and Qingxing, an orphan rescued by Sister Hui's mother from the original city, were still guarding the cousin. The others were driven away.
At first, there were people in the Lu family who were concerned about her illness and came to take care of her. They also knew that she could get some benefits if she loosened her grip. Later, they saw that she was not good at running the business and the money and money were getting less and less, so they became impatient and came over.
Especially after she read a few shabby books and thought that her cousin disliked philistine women the most, she simply gave all the money sent by the Ye family to her eldest aunt every month. In this way, those who wanted to take advantage went to please the eldest lady Fan, and this girl Ye Biao was gradually forgotten.
And she herself disliked tacky gold and silver jewelry and valuables, but several girls from the Lu family borrowed them in this way and that, without a trace, and the meat buns beat the dog.
When she knew that her cousin was worried about money management in order to study in the Imperial College, she was coaxed by her cousin's sweet words and handed over all the Zhuangzi shops to her eldest cousin. She only hoped that when she and her cousin got married together in the future, these things would be a help to her cousin. For her beloved cousin, she was willing to risk her life.
Perhaps Sister Hui could not have thought that these achievements she had made were the basis for the place in the back house to lose its use value and reach its end. In the end, only some slaves were willing to ask for a reward, and it depended on whether the watch girl was happy or not.
If there is one person in the Lu family who treats her really well, it is Lu Daihan, the direct daughter of the second wife of the Lu family, perhaps because they are more similar. Daihan's mother, Dong, has been dead for many years, and the current second wife, Xu, is very unkind to her, but Daihan still makes herself live a better life to show Xu.
So Dai Han would often come over to see Sister Hui, and he was also angry that his uncle's family had bullied her so much and made cousin Hui look like this. However, she was very quiet and could only come over to visit from time to time to comfort her.
The cousin girl who was still crying bitterly at this time had no idea whether this would hurt her body. Such a beautiful face was covered with crystal tears. Maybe she shed tears often, and her dark eyes could not be seen as charming. A woman who loves to cry may not be pitied by others after a long time. Maybe she is bored.
My cousin Ye Qinhui was like this. She cried for a long time every day when she looked at the flowers and leaves, the sunrise and sunset. She was reading some desolate poems, and she became even more sad and unstoppable, crying bitterly.
Therefore, most people can only see that cousin Ye Qinhui's eyes are red, swollen and bloodshot, and the area under her eyelids and around her nose are red, which greatly ruins her delicate appearance. It is said that women who love crying are the ugliest, or the term is appropriate here.
She looked extremely pale, she was out of breath from crying, and her body was extremely weak., there are at least a dozen tear-wiping handkerchiefs that she keeps with her every day. Unfortunately, the beauty often sheds tears and has nowhere to express her sorrow. It is already difficult for anyone to say a few words to her.
Looking inside the room, there is only a poplar canopy bed. The carving is not very good, and the materials used are not very particular. The tables, chairs and benches in the room are also of average quality. The clothes in the cabinet only have a few pieces of plain silk and satin, and there are no patterns embroidered on them.
On the lonely dressing table, there is a jewelry box made of golden nanmu. I heard that it was a gift from the emperor. There are many gold and silver jewelry in the box, but it may have been neglected for a long time, and the top is much duller, and there is still some dust in some places.
Only a few hostas on the dressing table were much shiny, probably because they were often worn. There was also a tea tray on the table inside the room, with only four blue and white porcelain tea cups on it. This was cousin Ye Qinhui's favorite tea set.
